::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 1st [after 1875]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MSS. Autogr. c.25 f270
:::

My dear [Mrs Buston](people/person_236.qmd)

We shall be very glad to see you and [Miss Dampier](people/person_404.qmd) at 3 o’clock on Wednesday - I shall have to leave you at 4, as it is the day of the [G F S](organizations/other_23.qmd) quarterly meeting, when the girls pay in their money - and I read to them[^2]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^2]: The Girls' Friendly Society was founded in 1875.

**Note:** Anne Mary Buston (1824/5-1895) was the wife of the Rev. Roger Buston (1807/8-mid 1880s), Vicar of Twyford, and mother of a numerous family.
